decisions.reason: Because A has remained only broadly mentioned rather than strongly commercialized and overlaps with the firm's stronger modular flagship direction, its likely results appear more at risk of falling below aspiration and prompting portfolio focus.
B stayed on its own page across 2023 and 2024, is close to the core shredding offer, and therefore likely meets or is near aspiration with manageable uncertainty.
As a flagship multi-model line that fits the firm's stated strategic direction toward modular cleaner solutions, C is the least likely to be withdrawn even if early results are still being learned.
E is a new 2024 line with several models close to established capabilities, so the firm likely gives it time under organisational slack unless clear underperformance emerges.
F is newer and somewhat more exploratory than the core shredder range, but its dedicated presentation and fit with the firm's modular processing portfolio support continued market presence for now.
